summary: Join our Sarbanes-Oxley Act training to boost your corporate compliance expertise. Learn key regulations and best practices for a compliant organization.
lede: SOX audit and compliance training helps finance, audit and governance professionals design and test internal controls for financial reporting. It covers management responsibilities, control weaknesses and remediation, IT safeguards, and recordkeeping. Participants also practice assessing control effectiveness, organizing audit trails and prioritizing risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals directly or indirectly involved in financial reporting, auditing, and compliance governance, seeking to enhance their understanding and implementation of SOX compliance frameworks.
audience: Chief Financial Officers (CFOs) and finance managers
modules: Understanding the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX): Background and Intent
SOX Section 302: Corporate Responsibility for Financial Reports
SOX Section 404: Management Assessment of Internal Controls
IT Controls and Data Integrity in SOX Compliance
SOX Section 802: Document Retention and Recordkeeping
Risk Assessment and Internal Audit Alignment
Sustaining a Culture of Compliance and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial accounting principles and corporate governance structures. Prior experience in finance, auditing, or compliance roles is recommended.
